Title: Successful Checkout Flow
Preconditions: User is on https://saucedemo.com with valid standard credentials
Steps:
1. Log in with standard_user/secret_sauce
2. Add 'Sauce Labs Backpack' to cart
3. Click Shopping Cart link
4. Click Checkout button
5. Enter First Name, Last Name, Postal Code
6. Click Continue and then Finish
Expected Result: User sees 'Thank you for your order!' confirmation

Title: Checkout With Missing Postal Code
Preconditions: User is on checkout step one page
Steps:
1. Enter First Name and Last Name
2. Leave Postal Code empty
3. Click Continue
Expected Result: Validation error displays 'Error: Postal Code is required'
